_doc: Copy of the builders wall, one entry per README language (keys = LOCALES in builders-core.mjs). Placeholders: {since} month of the first arrival, {week} people in the last 7 days, {ago} time since the latest arrival (Intl, localized), {n} people shown, {month} month during the build. captionQuiet replaces caption when fewer than WEEK_MIN people joined in the last 7 days. A language missing here is not rendered and the route serves English. en: narrative-ops + venture-ops, 17-oct-2026. Never translate: career-ops, CareerOps, GitHub; 'A room, not a club' / 'the door is open' take the wording that README already uses. Translations: career-ops-docs, 17-oct-2026 (es, fr, de, pt-BR, cn, zh-TW with its career-ops.org terminology; the rest without a native reviewer).
